G'oya

Sanadan yilni ajratib olasiz, shu yil bo'yicha guruhlaysiz va har guruhdagi qatorlarni sanaysiz. Yilni ajratadigan funksiya ikki bazada har xil nomlanadi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM registered_on)::int AS year, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM users
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
Faqat SQLiteSELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', registered_on) AS INTEGER) AS year, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM users
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

EXTRACT PostgreSQL'da NUMERIC qaytaradi, strftime esa SQLite'da matn ('2023'). Masala yilni butun son sifatida so'raydi, shuning uchun ikkalasi ham ::int yoki CAST(... AS INTEGER) bilan o'giriladi.

Tuzoqlar

Guruh yil bo'yicha bo'lishi kerak, sana bo'yicha emas. GROUP BY registered_on da har bir kun alohida guruh bo'ladi va namunada 2022-yil ikki qator bo'lib chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(registered_on AS TEXT), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM users
GROUP BY registered_on
ORDER BY 1

COUNT(DISTINCT registered_on) ham noto'g'ri: bir kunda ro'yxatdan o'tgan uch kishi bitta bo'lib sanaladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Sana matnga aylantirilsa (2023-07-08), yil uning birinchi to'rt belgisi. Bu ikkala bazada ishlaydi:

SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(registered_on AS TEXT), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM users
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

CAST(... AS TEXT) ni tashlab ketmang: SQLite'da SUBSTR(registered_on, 1, 4) ishlaydi, chunki sana u yerda baribir matn, PostgreSQL'da esa DATE ustunidan SUBSTR olib bo'lmaydi.
